name: Sustenance
body:
Your body can survive on the power of the spirits alone.

Benefit: While you are bound to at least one spirit, you do not need or eat or drink. When your occultist level reaches 10, you do not need to breathe while you are bound to at least one spirit, making you immune to inhaled effects and at no risk of suffocation.

Pact Magic Unbound, Vol. 1. ©, 2012, Radiance House. Author(s): Alexander Augunas, Dario Nardi
